# Atef Elsaeed

> Senior Flutter developer in Cairo, Egypt. Five years building production mobile apps in fintech, government and consumer products. Co-founder of Adrenaline Platform and Dikirnis On. The site is in English and Arabic.

## Pages

- [Home](https://atefelsaeed.github.io/): about, services, experience, featured projects, skills, contact
- [All projects](https://atefelsaeed.github.io/projects/): every project with its industry
- [Experience](https://atefelsaeed.github.io/experience/): jobs and what was built in each
- [Blog](https://atefelsaeed.github.io/blog/): articles, also on Medium
- [Arabic version](https://atefelsaeed.github.io/ar.html): the same pages in Arabic

## Case studies

- [Dikirnis On](https://atefelsaeed.github.io/projects/dikirnis/): local super-app built solo, 2,500+ users in 5 months
- [Prime Source](https://atefelsaeed.github.io/projects/prime-source/): Hajj operations app, cut from 250 MB to 85 MB
- [Miqat](https://atefelsaeed.github.io/projects/miqat/): free, ad-free Islamic companion app
- [RepoSphere](https://atefelsaeed.github.io/projects/reposphere/): one dashboard for GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps and Gitea repos, PRs and issues
- [Belmally ERP](https://atefelsaeed.github.io/projects/belmally/): ERP with a web app, a desktop POS and a mobile sales app
- [XPrinter](https://atefelsaeed.github.io/projects/xprinter/): Android app that prints PDFs on 80 mm Bluetooth thermal printers, used by a client
